editorial: You meet Matt Weston, a bored young CIA safe house keeper in Cape Town who wants real field work. His quiet day explodes when Tobin Frost, a legendary rogue agent, walks in with dangerous secrets and a team of killers on his tail. The safe house is attacked, forcing Matt to drag Tobin through the city while figuring out who betrayed them. The movie feels like a gritty chase with shaky camera action and tense standoffs. Denzel Washington plays Tobin with cool menace, while Ryan Reynolds sells Matt's panic and growth. The action is loud and frequent, though the plot can feel familiar and the shaky cam may bother some viewers. If you enjoy buddy thrillers with double crosses, this is a solid pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Matt learns his CIA boss is the traitor who wants Frost dead. Frost helps Matt survive the last shootout, then dies from his wounds after giving Matt a data drive with proof. Matt delivers the drive to a higher official, exposing the corruption. He walks away from the agency, finally becoming the field agent he wanted, but now wiser and alone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spy thrillers, buddy action, and Denzel Washington performances.
